decisions.reason: The client questions using a spout and requests gravity-based dispensing, but it is unclear whether the spout is eliminated or remains as the outlet of the gravity-fed mechanism; the source specifies no replacement geometry.
Changing the dispensing drive to gravity-based does not remove or alter the existing requirements to prevent leaks into the base and electronics.

The source may make the spout-specific cleaning method obsolete if the spout is eliminated, but a gravity-based dispenser may still use a cleanable outlet or spout; no replacement cleaning method is established.
The gravity-based dispensing decision does not change the general V1 priority or off-the-shelf sourcing policy and does not determine whether the new mechanism must be custom or off the shelf.
